title: Ravin bar Abba
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Chullin 86a: “But did not Ravin bar Abba say — and some say Rabbi Avin bar Sheva…” Dikdukei Soferim: Rabbi Avin bar Sheva, and some say Rabbi Avin bar Rav Sheva.[^1]

notes.text: The consulted Chullin 86a paragraph gives Ravin bar Abba and, alternatively, Rabbi Avin bar Sheva. The additional form attributed to Dikdukei Soferim remains Hyman’s apparatus report, without a fresh apparatus collation or identity merger.
